subject: Request: annual assurance report (Type II) + evidence rotation plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Request: annual assurance report (Type II) + evidence rotation plan

Hi Lisa —

Hope you’re well. We’re preparing for Acme’s procurement security review and wanted to request your recent SOC 2 Type II report (covering the 2025 audit period) plus any accompanying bridge letter that explains scope or complementary user-entity controls. A few specific asks to help our security team validate coverage quickly: 

- Auditor name and report date (so we can match to our records)
- Exact scope (services and control categories tested) and audit period dates
- Whether there are any carve-outs or subservice organizations
- A short CSV example (anonymized) showing log retention samples or access-review extracts — we use this to sanity-check signal coverage

If you prefer, we can accept an uploaded package to a presigned S3 link (we’ll provide) or a secure Drive folder. Our procurement window is tight — would you be able to share the report + bridge letter within 5 business days?

To speed things up internally, I’ve attached a short one-page summary (redwood_assurance_summary_2025.pdf) that explains how we present the artefacts to our security reviewers — we can also provide a templated reply if you want to delegate to a technical contact.

Thanks — and happy to set a quick 20-minute call if that’s easier.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: redwood_assurance_summary_2025.pdf (pdf)

From: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@acme-analytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:08:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: annual assurance report (Type II) + evidence rotation plan

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the clear list. We can share the Type II report and bridge letter. Quick clarifying questions before I surface to our security team: 

1) Which exact audit period do you need us to include in the bridge letter? (we have rolling reports for FY ending 2024 and FY ending 2025)
2) The CSV example — can it be pseudonymized? We want to avoid PHI/PII in shared extracts.
3) Preferred transfer method: presigned S3 vs. secure Drive link? We prefer SFTP for large packages but can do presigned links.

If you can confirm the audit period and whether sample extracts can be pseudonymized, I’ll get the package ready. I can also engage our auditor for an attestation paragraph if that’s helpful.

Lisa Chang
Senior Information Security Manager
Acme Analytics
---

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: annual assurance report (Type II) + evidence rotation plan

Lisa — thanks, and quick answers below: 

1) Audit period: please share the Type II covering the calendar 2025 audit period (Jan 1 2025 — Dec 31 2025) if available; if your FY naming differs, the report date + auditor name is sufficient for our reviewers.
2) Yes — pseudonymized samples are perfect. For the CSV example, columns we typically look at: timestamp, user_id (pseudonymized), event_type, resource, retention_days. We just want to confirm retention and sampling cadence.
3) Transfer: presigned S3 link is easiest for us. I’ve asked our infra team to generate one; if SFTP is required on your side we can switch.

Olga — can you please prepare the presigned upload and the short upload instructions (one-pager) we can send to Acme? Neha — please draft two short reply templates: (A) a minimal template for an exec to forward and (B) a technical handoff to their auditor. Keep them under 6 lines each.

Below are the upload details we’ll provide to Acme once Olga confirms. I’ve included a brief extract sample we’d accept.

---
Presigned upload: [will be provided in separate email]
Required file set:
- Full Type II report (pdf)
- Bridge letter addressing scope and period (pdf)
- Example evidence extract (csv; pseudonymized)
- Optional: auditor attestation email or contact
---

Thanks team.

Jonas
---

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@acme-analytics.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: annual assurance report (Type II) + evidence rotation plan

Hi Lisa —

Thanks — I created the presigned upload and a short instructions file. You can upload to the link below (valid for 7 days):

https://presigned.redwood-edge.com/upload/ACME-REQ-9982-20260914

Upload checklist (please include exactly these filenames when possible):
- ACME_TypeII_Report_2025.pdf
- ACME_Bridge_Letter_2025.pdf
- ACME_LogSample_Pseudonymized.csv
- (optional) ACME_Auditor_Attestation.txt

Quick one-line templates (feel free to paste):
A) Exec-forward (minimal):
"Hi — attaching Acme’s 2025 Type II report and a bridge letter for Redwood’s review. Let me know if you need a contact at our auditor. — Lisa"

B) Technical handoff (to your security/auditor):
"Hi team — per Redwood’s request, I’ve uploaded the 2025 Type II, bridge letter, and a pseudonymized log sample to the presigned link. Please confirm when you’ve validated scope and retention. — Lisa"

If you prefer SFTP instead, let me know and I’ll switch the transfer method.

Attachments: presigned_upload_instructions.txt, example_evidence_extract.csv

Best,
Olga Petrov
Trust Ops
Redwood Inference
